definitions.gloss: New Year's greeting, New Year's congratulations
definitions.explanation: A greeting or celebration for the New Year. Most commonly used in compounds like 年賀状 (New Year's card) and 年賀はがき (New Year's postcard).

examples.japanese: {年賀|ねんが}⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
{年賀|ねんが}{状|じょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepare New Year's cards in December.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年賀|ねんが}{状|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: I sent a hundred New Year's cards this year, so I'm looking forward to getting replies.

notes:
{年賀|ねんが} means New Year's greeting or congratulation. It is most commonly seen in compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- {年賀|ねんが}{状|じょう}: New Year's greeting card
- {年賀|ねんが}⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧: New Year's postcard (sold by Japan Post)
- {年賀|ねんが}{回|まわ}り: New Year's visits to friends and relatives

CULTURAL NOTE:
Sending {年賀|ねんが}{状|じょう} is a major tradition in Japan. Cards are prepared in December and delivered on January 1st. Each card typically includes a greeting, a brief personal message, and often an illustration of the zodiac animal for the coming year. In recent years, the number of cards sent has declined as more people use email or social media.
